finding: The adaptive stage changes model size under a penalized criterion. Moving q=4 to q=2 increases RSS while decreasing MSIC. The initial worker incorrectly imposed fixed-support RSS monotonicity on this varying-size history.
independent_core_audit: The core agent independently confirmed all 125 fixed candidates satisfy accepted-loss monotonicity, minimum visited loss, best-iteration pointer, RSS/loss equality, recomputed OLS RSS, capacity, and support consistency.
correction: Retain common support/capacity/finite/RSS consistency checks. Require monotonic accepted loss and best-visited metadata only for global-fixed. Explicitly reject unknown candidate kinds.
archive_policy: Rejected validator source and STOPPED outputs remain untouched. Corrected validator requires a new frozen plan and fresh output directory with the same predeclared data seeds; no resume, result copying, or mixed-source summary.
